messages:
maria: quick heads-up — ran a granularity probe this morning across apac/eu with mosaic-13b-q2b (8k context). noticed a fairness drift at small batch windows; kernel selection flips the tail behavior on a100 vs h100.
bench-bot: job 2003456789-gran-matrix started (nodes: apac-h100-2, eu-a100-2). logs: https://internal-logs/2003456789
sasha: can you paste the short matrix + salient numbers? curious about p95 and throughput tradeoffs.
maria: short paste below — this is raw (no postproc). window = max_batch_tokens window sizing in tokens.
```
window,gpu,kernel,lat_p50_ms,lat_p95_ms,tokens_per_s,fairness_score
8,a100,fused,18,64,12000,0.78
8,h100,fused,12,48,14000,0.92
32,a100,gemm,22,70,15000,0.85
32,h100,gemm,16,54,15500,0.89
128,a100,gemm,35,120,18000,0.95
128,h100,gemm,28,95,18500,0.97
```
kai: interesting — fused kernel on h100 drops p95 and improves fairness at small windows. any idea why fused beats gemm here? maybe attention kernel tiling interacts with smaller windows.
maria: hypothesis: fused kernel keeps KV cache/coalescing overhead lower when batches are small -> less microbursting. on a100 fused has higher p95 though; maybe kernel quality depends on tensor core paths.
anil: we should pick a single fairness metric we all agree on. propose: fairness_score = 1 - (p95/p50) clipped to [0,1]. closer to 1 is better (lower tail inflation).
sasha: +1 to the simple ratio. but also want throughput-normalized fairness: fairness_norm = fairness_score * (tokens_per_s / max_tokens_per_s).
maria: added both in a quick scatter plot: https://internal-charts/bench/2003456789/scatter — shows h100-fused clusters high fairness at window=8, while a100 needs window>=32 to match.
bench-bot: attached kernel-profiles (cpu/gpu counters) for run ids: 2003456789-01..04
maria: quick command used to launch (for repro):
```
./run_bench --model mosaic-13b --quant q2b --kernels fused,gemm --windows 8,32,128 --regions apac,eu --gpus h100,a100 --tpb 1 --duration 300
```
sasha: can we try one more sweep with hybrid-tiling turned on for a100 fused? that might reduce tail.
kai: also try lowering max_batch_tokens to 512 for the window=8 run — I suspect large max_batch_tokens hides some fairness issues.
anil: operational ask: if we recommend h100-fused for small-window low-latency customers, should we add an automated routing rule? maybe route <50ms target to h100-fused where available and fallback to a100-gemm.
maria: provisional recommendation: 
- small-window, latency-sensitive: h100 + fused kernel
- throughput-oriented, cost-sensitive: a100 + gemm at window>=32
notes: need extra validation on longer prompts (16k) and with real user prompt mix.
sasha: can you run a short quality eval (server-side) to ensure quantization + fused kernel doesn't regress generation tokens? sample set: 200 prompts from prod-synthetic.
maria: started eval job 2003456795-eval; will post results when done.
deploy-bot: canary rollout rule created: route.policy: {latency_target_ms:50, preferred: h100-fused, fallback: a100-gemm} (staged)
anil: thanks — next steps: (1) validate quality eval, (2) run hybrid-tiling sweep for a100-fused, (3) produce final recommendation + cost delta. I can own the cost calc.
maria: thanks all. ping me if you want raw CSVs, I have them in s3://redwood-bench/granularity/2003456789/*.csv :thumbsup:
sasha: nice work, this is a clean matrix. if eval looks good we'll include in the onboarding doc for mosaic-13b-q2b.
maria: will update thread with eval + final numbers when ready. closing for now.
